info.name: Get Metrics Combined with Dimensions for a Date Range

params.name: m
params.description: The metrics to fetch.

params.name: from
params.description: The beginning date of the date range. ISO8601 format 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ'

params.name: to
params.description: The end date of the date range. ISO8601 format 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ'

params.name: tz
params.description: Timezone used for calculations.

params.name: d
params.description: The dimensions to fetch.

params.name: f
params.description: The filter that will be applied to the events dimensions. Multiple filter parameters are joined with the AND operator.

params.name: fm
params.description: The filter that will be applied to the metrics. Multiple filter parameters are joined with the AND operator.

params.name: s
params.description: The field to order the results by. It must be a dimension, metric or custom dimension that was specified in the 'm' or the 'd' parameter.

params.name: p
params.description: The response's page to access, starting at 1.

params.name: n
params.description: The number of results to include in a page.

params.name: asc
params.description: Whether to sort by ascending order.

params.name: includeMetadata
params.description: Whether to include metadata regarding the results (total count and unique counts, if applicable).

params.name: format
params.description: The format of the response. Default is JSON.

params.name: bindOnLastSearch
params.description: bindOnLastSearch

params.name: org
params.description: The name of the organization (Coveo Cloud V2 only)

items.docs: There is one value of each metric for every possible dimension combination.

params.name: previousTo

info.name: Get Graph Data Points for Visit Based Metrics for a Date Range

params.name: m
params.description: The metrics to fetch.

params.name: from
params.description: The beginning date of the date range. ISO8601 format 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ'

params.name: to
params.description: The end date of the date range. ISO8601 format 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ'

params.name: tz
params.description: Timezone used for calculations.

params.name: f
params.description: The filter that will be applied to the events dimensions. Multiple filter parameters are joined with the AND operator.

params.name: hideEventFilters
params.description: Each specified filter is inverted in order to hide events. Multiple filter parameters are joined with the AND operator.

params.name: fn
params.description: The filter that will be applied to dimensions to exclude events from the results. Multiple filter parameters are joined with the AND operator.

params.name: i
params.description: The interval on which data will be grouped. Default value is DAY.

params.name: org
params.description: The name of the organization (Coveo Cloud V2 only)

items.docs: There is one data point per interval per metric. The interval can be specified with the 'i' query parameter.
